body: ﻿Moving to draft to address review findings: merge upstream/main, raise the UI test window height to 1200.0 for #3338, pin rotate_closed_loop_outside on the normalized seam vertex, and run the reached heavy lanes on the reworked head.

Merged `upstream/main` cleanly and kept both `Face` and `Engrave` in `avoid.rs`, `tools.rs`, `mcp-tools.md`, and `crates/ui/src/egui_app/tests/do_not_touch.rs` (head `70239a58ada714a958d38328fad9c12a639fd3fd`, `git merge-tree` exit 0 against `5346bd7ac`). Earlier review fixes are verified too: `trace_avoid_rotates_closed_loop_seam_around_overhead_plunge_blocker` passes and `do_not_touch.rs` sets harness height to `1200.0`. Fresh `gate-runner` checks pass on `70239a58a`: `camcraft-motion`, `camcraft-app`, `camcraft-ui` (1463 passed, 0 failed), `clippy` (exit 0), and `cargo xtask gate light` (3 steps, 0 failed). In `example_catalog`, 35 passed and only the two untouched `catalog_2d_drill_overfeed` tests fail locally on Windows CRLF (`core.autocrlf = true`).

This branch is ready for a re-check.

Needs changes before merge.

This is a SAFETY-tier review: the PR changes the Engrave toolpath when "Do not touch" is set.

## Earlier findings (review of `db8e12b4b`)

1. `crates/ui/src/egui_app/tests/do_not_touch.rs`: the harness height is now `1200.0`. `engrave_boundaries_shows_do_not_touch_controls_and_takes_picks` passes when merged with `upstream/main`. **Met.**
2. `crates/motion/tests/avoid_engrave.rs`: `trace_avoid_rotates_closed_loop_seam_around_overhead_plunge_blocker` now reads the normalized seam vertex. A mutation that skips `rotate_closed_loop_outside` now makes this test fail. **Met.**

## What looks good

- `trace_avoid` calls `trace` directly when `AvoidSpec` is empty. `empty_avoid_matches_plain_trace_exactly` and `engrave_without_do_not_touch_is_unchanged` pin this.
- The independent `verify_avoid` check in `generate.rs` runs after `trace_avoid`. A hit that the planner misses becomes a warning and blocks the post (`engrave_do_not_touch_refuses_impossible_cut_and_blocks_post`).
- `trace_avoid.rs` has 343 lines and a provenance header. It has no `unwrap`, `expect` or `panic` outside tests.
- No recorded program (`*.nc`, `*.cl`, `examples/catalog/**`) changed. No new crate dependency.

## Results merged with main

Ran locally in `.claude/worktrees/review-3549`, trial-merged with `upstream/main` (`6cfc0a6d4`):

- `cargo xtask gate quick --base upstream/main`, run as three parts:
  - `--only motion`: 88 steps, 0 failed.
  - `--only ui`: 10 steps, 0 failed (`camcraft-ui` lib, `boundary`, `boundary_picks`, `contour_dxf_sketch`, `sinker_setup`, `tap_hand`, `theme_example`, `theme_files`, `waterjet_tool`).
  - `--only app`: 667 steps, 1 failed. The failed step is `app suites: first_part_programs` (`first_router_part_posts_the_shipped_program`). This step is also red on `upstream/main` (#3574, cause on #3572: a stale `examples/first-router-part.nc`). This PR does not touch it.
- Pinning suites, all green: `avoid_engrave` 4/4, `do_not_touch_engrave` 3/3, `do_not_touch` 3/3, `do_not_touch_project`, `engrave_law` 10/10, `mcp_doc_drift`, `verify`.
- `cargo clippy -p camcraft-motion -p camcraft-app -p camcraft-ui --all-targets -- -D warnings`: passed.

### Extra suites run

- `example_catalog` (37 passed, 4 ignored), `example_catalog_adaptive`, `example_catalog_edge_work`, `golden_cl`, `solid_law_goldens`: all green (in the app quick run).
- The diff changes no file under `testdata/` and no importer code. No STEP or kernel suite applies.

### Safety-tier mutations

1. `trace_avoid.rs:155`: skip `rotate_closed_loop_outside` (always return `vec![run]`). `avoid_engrave` is **red** (`trace_avoid_rotates_closed_loop_seam_around_overhead_plunge_blocker`). Restored, green.
2. `trace_avoid.rs:243`: skip the trim of open runs whose end point is blocked (`if false && endpoints_blocked`). `avoid_engrave` stays **green**, and `do_not_touch_engrave` stays **green**. The mutation survives (finding 1).
3. `generate.rs:2320`: call plain `trace` when an `AvoidSpec` is set. `do_not_touch_engrave` is **red** (2 of 3 tests). Restored, green.

### Light and heavy lanes

- `cargo xtask gate light`: not run in this review. The PR body reports it green on this head (3 steps, 0 failed).
- Heavy lanes: not run. Finding 1 blocks this head, so this review cannot set `merge-ready`. Current `AGENTS.md` (#3556) does not require heavy lanes at review for a `P3` PR.

## Requested before merge

1. `crates/motion/src/machining2d/trace_avoid.rs:241-247`: no test pins the trim of an open run whose plunge or retract point is under an overhead obstacle (`endpoints_blocked` -> `trim_open_run`). Mutation 2 removes this branch, and all tests stay green. The branch is necessary. I made a local test that I did not commit:
   - Use the square `rect_loop(-20, -20, 20, 20)` with `stepped_cutter()` and `base_trace()`.
   - Add one protected item with the edge `([-2, 20, -1], [2, 20, -1])`. This edge breaks the north side at the cut depth.
   - Add an overhead bridge `box_facets([3, 12, 38], [14, 28, 42])` above one break point.
   - On this head, `trace_avoid` gives no `avoid_hits`, and the first plunge moves to x = -11.04.
   - With mutation 2, `avoid_hits` gives three `Holder` hits (moves 0, 1 and 7).

   Add a test of this type to `crates/motion/tests/avoid_engrave.rs`. Assert that `avoid_hits` is empty. Also assert that the plunge and retract points of each open run are outside the overhead keep-out. Then make sure that mutation 2 makes the test fail.

## Questions / notes (not blocking)

- A level that is fully blocked gets a path note. A span that is trimmed inside a level gets no note. The engraving can then lose a segment and the user does not see why. Think about one note per trimmed level, or file a `P7` follow-up.
- `crates/ui/src/egui_app/tests/do_not_touch.rs` has 407 lines after the merge with main. This is more than the 400-line guideline.
- `.claude/skills/camcraft-mcp/SKILL.md:169` still names only `2D Offset` and `3D Pocket` for `set_operation_do_not_touch`. It is a process file, so a follow-up is correct.
- The diff changes only a test file in `crates/ui`, so this review requests no screenshots.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.
